newsitem.title: USA: Northwest August load factor dips.
newsitem.headline: Northwest August load factor dips.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Inc said Monday its systemwide passenger load factor for August dropped 0.2 percentage points to 80.6 percent from 80.8 percent in August 1995.
Northwest said its domestic passenger load factor dropped to 76.0 percent in August from 76.5 percent a year ago, and its international load factor fell to 87.1 percent from 87.3 percent.
Systemwide, available seat miles in August rose 8.5 percent to 8.59 billion from 7.92 billion. Revenue passenger miles gained 8.1 percent to 6.92 billion from 6.40 billion.
Systemwide cargo ton miles rose 5.4 percent to 197.3 million from 187.3 million.
